events.event: Danantara's Dony Oskaria says after being summoned to the Palace that Danantara Investment will buy more shares of listed BUMN with strong fundamentals after the MSCI-driven sell-off, naming no targets or amounts.
events.key_numbers: IHSG close 19 Oct 4,996.61 (-188.50 pts, -3.64%) · LQ45 488.46 (-3.95%) · 691 stocks fell vs 103 rose · turnover Rp25.17 T · no target companies or amount disclosed
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether state money will be used to cushion the stock market crash and what it means for BUMN share prices.

events.event: Danantara says it wants to move from leasing land to owning parts of the AI data-centre value chain (chips, AI controllers), targeting over Rp30 trillion of economic value, and will push deals at its DTIIF forum on 26-28 Oct.
events.key_numbers: Rp30 T+ (~US$1.7 B) · per 100 MW: land lease only = revenue US$100-150 M vs strategic partnership = US$1.5-1.7 B (investment US$3-4 B) · chip/controller supply queue 16-48 months · DTIIF 26-28 Oct Jakarta, 1,500+ participants · Arm signed cooperation
events.why_it_matters: Indonesia wants more than rent from the AI boom, but data centres use lots of power and water.

events.event: Katadata reports Nvidia is exploring a US$4.5 billion data-centre/AI investment in Batam, per Airlangga Hartarto; the plan is still at discussion stage while a BDx data-centre project at Jatiluhur was halted over permits.
events.key_numbers: US$4.5 B (~Rp81.2 T) · Indonesia operating data-centre capacity 600-700 MW · pipeline 1.3 GW / US$15-20 B · BDx CGK4 Jatiluhur up to 640 MW, groundbreaking 22 Sep then halted (AMDAL/PBG) · Zankore (Indosat) target 1 GW in 3 years
events.why_it_matters: Huge AI money may come to Batam, but critics link data centres to blackouts and water use.

events.event: Komdigi opens Bali Tech Week 2026 in Sanur; Minister Meutya Hafid sets out three pillars (connected, growing, protected) and cites internet and digital-economy figures. (update of E0035)
events.key_numbers: ~235 M internet users (81.72% penetration) · 4G covers 98.96% of population · digital GMV US$99 B in 2025 (+14%) · Garuda Spark 178 programs, 15,700 talents, Rp429.5 B investment · BTW 19-23 Oct, 4,000+ participants, 1,000 foreign delegates
events.why_it_matters: Government's digital agenda and investor pitch for the year.

events.event: Komdigi says it has acted on more than 4.2 million online-gambling website content items as of October 2026, at the ICANN87 opening in Bali.
events.key_numbers: 4.2 M+ content items acted on (Oct 2026) · ICANN87 17-22 Oct, Nusa Dua
events.why_it_matters: Shows scale of the judol crackdown, though blocking has not ended the problem.

events.event: Komdigi (Deputy Minister Nezar Patria) is preparing a derivative rule under Perpres 27/2026 (issued 8 Oct) setting a formula, not fixed min/max tariffs, for ojol food and goods delivery fees, due before 31 Dec 2026.
events.key_numbers: Perpres 27/2026 issued 8 Oct 2026 · derivative rule targeted before 31 Dec 2026 · fee depends on weight/dimension/type of goods
events.why_it_matters: Could change what you pay for GoFood/GrabFood delivery and what drivers earn.

events.event: Under Ministerial Regulation 3/2026, e-commerce platforms such as Shopee and TikTok Shop must cut admin/commission fees by at least 50% for verified micro and small domestic-product sellers from 25 Oct, applied through Sapa UMKM.
events.key_numbers: At least 50% fee cut · starts 25 Oct 2026 · verification up to 10 days · payout within 5 days · micro: capital up to Rp1 B or sales up to Rp2 B · small: sales up to Rp15 B · Kepmen UMKM 398/2026
events.why_it_matters: Online sellers can get lower fees; important for UMKM sellers and consumers watching prices.

events.event: OJK data show pinjol (P2P lending) bad-loan ratio TWP90 at 4.73% in August 2026, close to the 5% threshold, with 16 operators above 5%; OJK is drafting rules to protect lenders after operator failures.
events.key_numbers: Outstanding Rp106.94 T (+22.07% y/y) · TWP90 4.73% (2.60% Aug 2025; 4.32% Jul 2026) · 16 operators above 5% · draft: default threshold 90 to 180 days, pooling fund 5% of net fees, liquidation reserve 20% of min equity
events.why_it_matters: Rising defaults on online loans signal strain on household finances.

events.event: SpaceX agreed to buy up to 14 MHz paired 800 MHz spectrum for Starlink Mobile; CNBC Indonesia flags a possible future threat to Telkomsel, Indosat and XLSmart, though nothing is announced for Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: 14 MHz paired 800 MHz (announced 8 Oct) · Komdigi 700 MHz/2.6 GHz auction: XL Rp1.06 T (30 MHz), Telkomsel Rp642.5 B (20 MHz), Indosat Rp507.48 B (20 MHz)
events.why_it_matters: Speculative, but could reshape mobile competition and prices in the longer term.

events.event: Ceramic association Asaki says gas supply restrictions are cutting production and spreading layoffs: about 500 laid off in July and about 900 on furlough.
events.key_numbers: ~1,400-1,500 workers affected · 500 laid off July · 900 furloughed · utilisation below 70% in Oct (75% Jan-Aug; target 78-80%) · may fall to ~60% Nov-Dec
events.why_it_matters: Another sign of factory job cuts, this time from energy supply.

events.event: PIHPS national averages for 19 Oct show chilli and shallot prices jumping while rice super grades, eggs and chicken ease.
events.key_numbers: Cabai merah keriting Rp126,400/kg (+43.07%) · cabai rawit merah Rp119,250 (+13.25%) · bawang merah Rp43,800 (+18.38%) · daging sapi I Rp159,250 (+4.39%) · minyak kemasan merek 1 Rp25,750 (+5.75%) · telur Rp29,100 (-2.02%) · ayam Rp40,150 (-2.67%) · changes vs previous day
events.why_it_matters: Chilli and shallots hit household kitchens; daily moves can be noisy so confirm with later data.

events.event: BCA (BBCA) is scheduled to release Q3 2026 results on 20 Oct, the first big bank, followed by BBNI 23 Oct, BMRI 27 Oct, BRIS 29 Oct and BBRI/BBTN/BDMN 30 Oct; BRI Danareksa warns tightening liquidity could pressure H2 profit.
events.key_numbers: BBCA 20 Oct · BBNI 23 Oct · BMRI 27 Oct · BRIS 29 Oct · BBRI, BBTN, BDMN 30 Oct
events.why_it_matters: Bank results will show how hard the market crash and weak demand hit the biggest lenders.

events.event: DJP changed Coretax tax-return correction scheme to 'replace' from 1 Oct 2026 (PER-12/PJ/2026), and taxpayers complained about a new Coretax interface and unresponsive menus on 12-13 Oct; DJP says the issue is fixed.
events.key_numbers: Replace scheme from 1 Oct 2026 · PER-12/PJ/2026 · complaint count not given
events.why_it_matters: Government tax app problems affect many taxpayers and businesses.
